name: Winter's Presents
summary: In Ironforge, revelers are gathering for the Feast of Winter Veil. They point travelers toward Greatfather Winter beside the Smokywood Pastures stalls, where gifts wait beneath the holiday tree.

sections.title: A Season of Cheer
sections.body: Ironforge fills with Feast of Winter Veil cheer as winter settles over Khaz Modan. Revelers and holiday enthusiasts send passersby toward the decorated tree near the Smokywood Pastures vendors.

sections.title: Smokywood Pastures and Greatfather Winter
sections.body: Smokywood Pastures, a goblin enterprise, shares the season with Greatfather Winter. He greets visitors while goblin merchants remind gift recipients that their festive treats and seasonal wares make gifts for friends and family.

faq.q: Who sends me to speak with Greatfather Winter?
faq.answer: A Holiday Enthusiast or a Wonderform Operator at an Ironforge PX-238 Winter Wondervolt machine invites you to visit Greatfather Winter at the decorated tree.

faq.q: Where can I find Greatfather Winter in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Greatfather Winter sits beside the festive tree and Smokywood Pastures vendor stalls in Ironforge, welcoming visitors of every Alliance race.

faq.q: What is the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt mentioned by the operator?
faq.answer: Goblin operators run the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt, a holiday invention that briefly disguises festival-goers as merry little holiday helpers.

faq.q: Why is Smokywood Pastures involved in Winter Veil?
faq.answer: Smokywood Pastures is a goblin merchant organization that sponsors seasonal treats, holiday novelties, and feasts across Azeroth, joining festive spirit with seasonal commerce.

faq.q: Can Horde players do this quest?
faq.answer: No. This invitation is for the Alliance in Ironforge. The Horde celebrates Winter Veil with Greatfather Winter in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What happens after speaking to Greatfather Winter?
faq.answer: Greatfather Winter welcomes you, says he has not forgotten you, and encourages you to look at the colorful packages beneath the holiday tree.

angles.text: Ironforge gathers Alliance races for the winter season, bringing elves, humans, and gnomes together to share festive cheer.
For dwarves, welcoming travelers to the Feast of Winter Veil in the Great Forge brings lively song, warm hearth fires, and cold ale to their mountain home.
As a gnome, you can marvel at the holiday contraptions brought in for the season, including PX-238 Winter Wondervolts operated across town.
